title: How China-Origin Vision-Language Models Move from Refusal to Reframing in State Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2608.11816v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: State-aligned distortion has been documented in China-origin text-based large language models (LLMs), but whether, and in what form, it arises in multimodal systems has not been systematically examined. We construct a balanced benchmark of 200 core entries spanning ten politically sensitive topics, plus a seven-variant visual-abstraction probe, and run nine vision-language models (VLMs), seven China-origin and two non-China, across four elicitation paradigms and two prompt languages, yielding 21,708 trials. Each response is audited on six dimensions -- explicit refusal, information integrity, visual grounding, state-aligned framing, language consistency, and response length -- by two independent frontier LLM judges, validated against three human experts on a 200-trial sample. translated_title: 中国起源的视觉-语言模型在国家对齐中如何从拒绝转向重构
translated_abstract: 国家对齐扭曲已在源自中国的基于文本的大型语言模型（LLM）中得到记录，但其是否以及以何种形式出现在多模态系统中尚未得到系统研究。我们构建了一个包含200个核心条目、覆盖十个政治敏感主题的平衡基准，以及一个七变体视觉抽象探针，并在四种诱发范式和两种提示语言下运行了九个视觉-语言模型（VLM），其中七个源自中国，两个非中国，共产生21,708次试验。每个响应在六个维度上进行审计——明确拒绝、信息完整性、视觉基础、国家对齐框架、语言一致性和响应长度——由两个独立的边界前沿LLM评判员执行，并在200次试验样本上与三位人类专家进行验证。单独测量每个维度使我们能够将多模态审查分解为个体信号，而非单一的基于拒绝的分数；特别是，拒绝行为被进一步分析，以揭示其动态变化。
tldr: 本研究通过多维度审计和多模态基准，揭示了中国起源的视觉-语言模型在国家对齐中从直接拒绝转向更微妙的重新框架策略，而非仅依赖单一拒绝机制。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that China-origin vision-language models shift from explicit refusal to subtle reframing strategies in state alignment, as shown by multi-dimensional auditing across a multimodal benchmark.
